name: FrameDecks
intro: A ministry-focused platform designed to help churches, Bible studies, prayer groups, discipleship communities, and Christian fellowship groups create meaningful Christ-centered gatherings.
mission: To strengthen Christian communities by making online meetings more engaging, organized, and centered on biblical truth.
vision: To see every online gathering become a place where God’s Word is clearly shared, believers are encouraged, disciples are equipped, and lives are transformed for the glory of God.

why.lead: Technology should never distract from ministry.
why.text: Too often leaders spend valuable time managing slides, searching for content, troubleshooting screens, and navigating complicated software. FrameDecks was created to remove those distractions so leaders can focus on what matters most:

values.title: Christ-Centered
values.text: Everything begins with Scripture and points people to Jesus.

values.title: Servant-Hearted
values.text: Built to support those who faithfully serve others.

values.title: Simple by Design
values.text: Technology should empower ministry, not complicate it.

values.title: Excellence for God’s Glory
values.text: Pursuing quality as an act of stewardship and worship.

scriptures.text: And let us consider how to stir up one another to love and good works, not neglecting to meet together, as is the habit of some, but encouraging one another, and all the more as you see the Day drawing near.
Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly, teaching and admonishing one another in all wisdom, singing psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, with thankfulness in your hearts to God.
And what you have heard from me in the presence of many witnesses entrust to faithful men, who will be able to teach others also.
And they devoted themselves to the apostles’ teaching and the fellowship, to the breaking of bread and the prayers.

Go therefore and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, teaching them to observe all that I have commanded you. And behold, I am with you always, to the end of the age.

heart.prayer: We pray FrameDecks helps leaders create spaces where people encounter God’s truth and experience authentic Christian fellowship.

creator.name: Shobin Mathews
story: FrameDecks began in the middle of ministry, not in a boardroom. Week after week, leading online Bible studies meant juggling slides, verses, questions and screens while trying to stay present with the people in the group.

Years of work in enterprise IT made one thing clear: good technology should quietly serve the people using it. So this platform was built to do exactly that, so a leader can keep their eyes on God’s Word and on the people God has entrusted to them.

journey.title: Follower of Jesus Christ
journey.text: Where every part of this story begins.

journey.title: Leader
journey.text: Serving in online Bible study groups, and seeing leaders wrestle with technology during gatherings.

journey.title: FrameDecks
journey.text: A platform that lets leaders focus on people and the Word.

lines: Our goal is never technology for technology’s sake.
Our goal is helping believers gather around God’s Word.

join.thanks: Thank you for serving God’s people.
join.text: Whether you lead a Bible study, facilitate discussion groups, mentor disciples, teach Scripture, coordinate ministries, or shepherd believers, we pray FrameDecks becomes a blessing to your ministry.

footer: Built for ministry, discipleship, prayer, fellowship, and the glory of God.
disclaimer: FrameDecks is an independent ministry tool created by Shobin Mathews.
